app-caches.library-caches.name: App caches
app-caches.library-caches.line: Copies apps keep to open things faster
app-caches.library-caches.what: Files apps save so they don't fetch or build them twice.
app-caches.library-caches.made-by: The apps themselves; each item names its app.
app-caches.library-caches.if-removed: Nothing is lost. Some apps open a little slower once.
app-caches.library-caches.comes-back: Yes, by itself, the next time the app needs it.
app-caches.browsers.name: Browser caches
app-caches.browsers.line: Pages and images browsers keep to load faster
app-caches.browsers.what: Copies of web pages and pictures your browsers keep so sites open faster.
app-caches.browsers.made-by: Your browsers; each item names its browser and profile.
app-caches.browsers.if-removed: Nothing you saved is lost. Your history, bookmarks, passwords, cookies and open tabs stay.
app-caches.browsers.comes-back: Yes, as you browse; sites may open a little slower the first time.
app-caches.web-engine.name: Web-based app caches
app-caches.web-engine.line: Caches of apps built on web pages
app-caches.web-engine.what: Files apps built on web pages, such as chat apps and code editors, keep to run faster.
app-caches.web-engine.made-by: The apps themselves; each item names its app.
app-caches.web-engine.if-removed: Nothing is lost. Your messages, files, settings and sign-ins stay.
app-caches.web-engine.comes-back: Yes, by itself; the app's next start may be slower.
app-caches.enabled.label: App caches
app-caches.enabled.description: Finds the caches of your installed apps while each app is closed. The apps make them again.
app-caches.reason: {app} keeps {size} here to work faster. It is closed now and makes the cache again when it needs it.
app-caches.left-out.special: A running program may be using it, so it is kept.
app-caches.left-out.not-yours: Some of it belongs to macOS or another user, or is locked, so only an administrator can remove it.
app-caches.left-out.no-system: Fresher could not list your open apps, so it keeps this. Scan again.
app-caches.left-out.app-open: This app, or a part of it, is open and may be using its cache. Quit it and scan again.
